verdict.rationale: RudderStack has an Audiences feature for building warehouse-based audiences (docs-6, docs-27). Its homepage makes a general marketing claim that AI-powered chat interfaces let business teams 'analyze, segment, and activate data' (docs-51), and a Slack AI agent can manage the workspace (docs-11). The documented MCP capabilities (docs-48), however, cover debugging, transformations, tracking plans and audit logs, not audience building. Missing for 10: documented natural-language-to-segment-definition generation, a review/approval step for AI-drafted audiences, grounding in the user's actual warehouse schema, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
